visual_review.identity: Warm dark-brown compact soil with gray-brown angular stone groups and sparse dry ochre tufts, fully continuous opaque material. No added cemetery objects or wet pools.
visual_review.detail_density: Roughly 15-20 recognizable accent groups, including about 9 tufts; original many tiny stones greatly reduced. Soil still has low-contrast fine mottling and ragged micro edges rather than the completely flat clean interiors requested.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Main stone faces and tuft groups are larger than the proposed 2-6 world-unit accent size: roughly 6-14 units at 256 world period. This is a measured visual estimate, not a registration constraint.
visual_review.style_caveat: Chunky stones but tufts have several small pointed leaves and ground has residual fine texture. Parent review at proposed world scale is needed; source preserved unchanged.
visual_review.native_acceptance: Opaque/dimensions passed, semantic identity retained; source candidate, not claimed scene acceptance or seamlessness.
